# corpus-bad-missing-reference - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the planner repairing a citation that points at nothing.
**Outcome:** lint names the missing existing source at its exact References line.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；1 个结构错误；缺失既有引用必须被预检拒绝。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 计划中的既有引用都能被解析。 | 2 修复缺失引用。 |
| GAP-1 | 计划引用了不存在的既有源码。 | 2 关闭。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1
- Wave 2: task 2

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 更新引用文档
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 更新 `docs/fidelity.md` 中关于引用分类的说明；不修改预检器。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: 2
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/review-lint.test.mjs` 退出 0。
  QA scenarios: Happy “docs-updated” 说明与解析器一致。Failure “docs-drift” 说明与代码不一致时人工复核。
  Commit: Y | docs(review): describe reference classes

- [ ] 2. 复用缺失的既有源码
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 按 `lib/absent-plan-source.js:12-14` 的既有实现补齐校验；不新建文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: F1
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`lib/absent-plan-source.js:12-14`；`$E/task-2.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/review-lint.test.mjs` 退出 0。
  QA scenarios: Happy “citation-resolves” 引用可被解析。Failure “silent-pass” 缺失引用被忽略。
  Commit: Y | fix(review): cite the existing source

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit
  What to do / Must NOT do: 只读核对每个 todo 与证据；不修改任何文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 3 | Blocked by: 2 | Blocks: —
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 每项都有证据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交

## Commit strategy
- 每个 N 项与测试一起提交。
